text: Skip to content Birchdale Road Medical Centre 2 Birchdale Road, Forest Gate, London, E7 8AR | 02084 721600 Search this website Search Online Services Home Appointments Prescriptions Our Practice Health Information News Contact HomeAbout Our SurgeryNew Patients New Patients Registration with the practice All new patients are offered a health check with a member of our healthcare team. This ensures that any necessary tests are up to date and that we have an accurate record of any repeat medication you may be taking. Medical treatment is available from the date of registration. For further information, please contact reception. When filling out the registration form, it is important to complete all fields to comply with Health Authority requirements: Previous surname (if any) Town and country of birth Home address with postcode Telephone number Previous address Name and address of previous GP If applicable, date of arrival in the UK Once your completed forms are submitted and reviewed by our team, you will be registered within 7 working days. Accountable Named GP The accountable named GP for patients registered at the practice is Dr M.S. Esmail, who is responsible for overseeing your overall care. Patients may book appointments with any GP at the practice. While we will always try to accommodate requests, we cannot guarantee that you will see a specific doctor.
